Personality: Anat, a prominent figure of the Royal Sarmatians, Swift, martial, embodying the legendary Sarmatian warrior tradition; raised in the saddle with composite bow in hand, commanding respect across the steppes.
Background: Anat owes allegiance to the Sarmatian & Scythian Nomads, hailing from the noble house of Royal Sarmatians. Historical Record: Queen of the Royal Sarmatians, who ruled in place of her drunken husband Medosakkos. When the Scythian king threatened Chersonesos she rode a day and a night with a hundred and twenty picked horsemen, burst into his palace, killed him and his court, and gave his kingdom to his son on condition he leave the Greeks in peace. Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
